quote: Where sidewalks are provided it shall be unlawful for any pedestrian to walk along and upon an adjacent roadway.

activation.condition: A sidewalk is provided beside an adjacent roadway.

obligation.description: A pedestrian does not walk along and upon that adjacent roadway when the sidewalk is provided.

timing.description: Observe complete original body and walking progress throughout the captured route.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Sidewalk purpose and actual provision require reviewed site evidence.
Measure original full-body afoot occupancy and longitudinal progress.
Separate roadway, shoulder, sidewalk and trail boundaries.
